policy: syntax-directed decomposition only; no solving, semantic normalization, or truth claim

rules.description: Retain a prove-mode truth statement as one exact atomic obligation without evaluating its value.
Retain a prove-mode relation statement as one exact atomic obligation without evaluating its operands.
Retain a prove-mode negation as one exact obligation without rewriting or pushing negation inward.
Split a prove-mode conjunction into all ordered operand obligations.
Expose every ordered disjunct as an explicit unselected alternative and retain a choice-required parent.
Place the implication antecedent in the child local context and decompose only the consequent as a required obligation.
Create both ordered implication directions under their exact opposite-side local hypotheses.
Extend the local binder context in declared order and decompose the universal body.
Expose exact witness-construction and body-verification duties using symbolic placeholders only.
Expose witness-construction, body-verification, and uniqueness duties without synthesizing a uniqueness formula.
Retain a refute-mode goal as one exact counterexample-shaped obligation without negating or searching it.
Retain a find-witness goal as one exact witness-search obligation without constructing a witness.
Retain a compute-mode goal as one exact computation obligation without evaluation.
Retain a classify-mode goal as one exact classification obligation without class inference.
Retain an optimize-mode goal as one exact optimization obligation without search or bound claims.
Record an exact symbolic witness-construction component for declared bound variables.
Record exact body verification under declared symbolic witness placeholders.
Record the undecomposed uniqueness duty against the original exists-unique statement.
Retain a future or unrecognized statement or goal shape as an explicit unsupported obligation.
